chapter_name: An Overview of Recombinant DNA Technology
learning_objective: 🧬 Master the basics of genetic engineering and learn how scientists cut, copy, and paste DNA to create entirely new genetic combinations!

key_vocabulary.hindi_meaning: पुनर्योगज डीएनए (दो अलग-अलग स्रोतों से जुड़ा डीएनए)
जेल इलेक्ट्रोफोरेसिस (डीएनए के टुकड़ों को अलग करने की तकनीक)

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Restriction enzymes act as molecular scissors. They recognize specific palindromic sequences (like MADAM) in DNA and cut the strands, often leaving 'sticky ends' that can easily join with other DNA segments.
Once the target DNA and vector DNA are cut with the same restriction enzyme, an enzyme called DNA Ligase is used to join them together. It forms phosphodiester bonds, sealing the DNA backbone.
Recombinant DNA (rDNA) is an artificial DNA molecule created by joining DNA from two different species. For example, inserting a human insulin gene into a bacterial plasmid.

Gel electrophoresis is used to separate cut DNA fragments based on their size. Since DNA is negatively charged, it moves towards the positive anode under an electric field. Smaller pieces travel faster and further.
The process of introducing the newly formed recombinant DNA into a host cell (like E. coli) so that the host can replicate it and express the desired protein.

fun_activity.title: 🔍 Find the Palindrome!
fun_activity.instructions: Restriction enzymes look for palindromes in DNA. A DNA palindrome reads the same on both strands in the 5' to 3' direction. Try writing the complementary strand for 5'-GAATTC-3'. You'll get 3'-CTTAAG-5'. Read the bottom one backwards—it's exactly the same! (This is the site for EcoRI).

exam_tips: 📌 Always remember the naming convention of restriction enzymes: EcoRI comes from E (Escherichia), co (coli), R (strain RY13), and I (first enzyme discovered).
📌 DNA fragments in gel electrophoresis separate strictly based on size (molecular weight), moving towards the anode (+).
📌 Emphasize that both the source DNA and vector DNA MUST be cut with the same restriction enzyme to produce complementary sticky ends.
quick_recap: ⭐ Herbert Boyer and Stanley Cohen created the first recombinant DNA in 1972.
⭐ HindII was the first restriction endonuclease to be discovered.
⭐ Ethidium bromide (EtBr) is used to stain DNA in gel electrophoresis, making it glow bright orange under UV light.
